name: glassbox
description: Fast typed decisions about code, with probabilities, confidence and checked reasons. Runs on your Claude Code model through the claude CLI, so no extra keys.

backend.title: Backend
backend.description: Which model glassbox asks. auto (default) uses the host agent's own CLI (claude -p in Claude Code), so no key is needed. anthropic and openai-compat are optional API backends for CI or headless use.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model id for the chosen backend. Leave empty for the default (haiku for claude-cli).

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: How much work each glassbox call does. fast: 1 sample, 1 option order, no evidence. balanced (default): the standard checks. explained: adds evidence and a one-line why. strict: more samples and higher bands. auto: fast first, then explained when the answer is not in the act band. GLASSBOX_MODE and .glassbox/config.json override it.

enable_hooks.title: Enable hooks
enable_hooks.description: Mark edited files stale after Edit, Write and MultiEdit (a background worker re-tags them within a daily budget), and refresh the AGENTS.md block at session start. Only acts in repos where you ran `glassbox init`.

ambient.title: Ambient context
ambient.description: Before each prompt that looks like it is about code, add up to about 1,500 characters of matching file:line locations and tags from the glassbox graph. No model call, typically well under 300 ms. Only acts in repos where you ran `glassbox init`. GLASSBOX_AMBIENT and .glassbox/config.json override it.

gate.title: End-of-turn gate
gate.description: When a turn changed code, rate the diff with glassbox triage in fast mode (on your Claude Code model). If a hunk is High risk with high confidence, ask Claude once to check those lines before finishing. Runs once per diff, gives up after 45 seconds and never blocks twice in a row. GLASSBOX_GATE and .glassbox/config.json override it.

concise_rules.title: Concise rules in AGENTS.md
concise_rules.description: Add the concise answer rules (cite file:line, one-line reasons, no recap, no pasted unchanged code) to the glassbox block in AGENTS.md, for Codex and other agents. In Claude Code, select the output style with /output-style glassbox:concise instead.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key (optional)
anthropic_api_key.description: Only for the anthropic backend. Not needed with auto or claude-cli.

openai_base_url.title: OpenAI-compatible base URL (optional)
openai_base_url.description: Only for the openai-compat backend, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1.
